user.title: Presence Simulator
user.description: Configure the lights used for presence simulation.

data_description.lights: Select the lights that may be controlled by the simulator.

init.title: Presence Simulator settings
init.description: Configure activity windows, timing ranges, and concurrency.

data_description.activity_window_mode: Choose between a fixed time window or a sun-based window.
data_description.lights: Select the lights that may be controlled by the simulator.
data_description.fixed_start_time: Start of the fixed activity window.
data_description.fixed_end_time: End of the fixed activity window. Overnight ranges are supported.
data_description.fixed_weekdays: Days on which the fixed activity window is allowed.
data_description.sun_start_event: Sunrise or sunset used to start the activity window.
data_description.sun_start_offset_minutes: Offset in minutes relative to the selected start event. Negative values start earlier.
data_description.sun_end_event: Sunrise or sunset used to end the activity window.
data_description.sun_end_offset_minutes: Offset in minutes relative to the selected end event. Positive values end later.
data_description.min_initial_delay_minutes: Minimum delay before each light's first possible activity when a window starts.
data_description.max_initial_delay_minutes: Maximum delay before each light's first possible activity when a window starts.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Minimum time a simulated light remains ON.
data_description.max_on_minutes: Maximum time a simulated light remains ON.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Minimum waiting time before that light may become active again.
data_description.max_off_minutes: Maximum waiting time before that light may become active again.
data_description.max_simultaneous: Maximum number of simulated lights that may be ON at the same time.

error.min_on_greater_than_max: Minimum ON time cannot be greater than maximum ON time.
error.min_off_greater_than_max: Minimum OFF time cannot be greater than maximum OFF time.
error.min_initial_delay_greater_than_max: Minimum initial delay cannot be greater than maximum initial delay.
